gaps.label: GitHub publication authentication
gaps.impact: Remote GitHub mirror cannot be completed until gh auth is configured.
gaps.nextAction: Run publish preflight after authentication is available and push only when clean.
gaps.closureMetric: GitHub server HEAD matches local UIXAppTTR after one authenticated push.
gaps.rollback: Keep local commits preserved in iCloud and do not retry push loops.

gaps.label: Visual runtime evidence
gaps.impact: Heavy cinematic mode has static checks but still needs bounded browser evidence.
gaps.nextAction: Run a visual smoke check only when Browser or Playwright is available.
gaps.closureMetric: Desktop and mobile screenshots show nonblank hero canvas, stable layout, and visible reduced-motion fallback.
gaps.rollback: Keep heavy mode optional and reduced-motion aware.

gaps.label: Mobile performance pass
gaps.impact: Heavy animation is clamped for compact devices but still needs real-device review.
gaps.nextAction: Review touch feedback, section reveal density, and canvas particle budget on mobile.
gaps.closureMetric: Compact devices default to balanced motion and all interactive cards keep stable dimensions.
gaps.rollback: Default compact devices to balanced motion.

gaps.label: Accessibility motion regression
gaps.impact: Reduced-motion and motion equivalence must stay visible after cinematic changes.
gaps.nextAction: Add checks and UI signals whenever motion tokens change.
gaps.closureMetric: Motion, accessibility affordance, and experience scorecard contracts all pass after animation changes.
gaps.rollback: Disable motion intensity effects through reduced-motion CSS and JS guards.

gaps.label: Server target credentials
gaps.impact: Upload or deployment cannot run until target host, user, and path are explicit.
gaps.nextAction: Keep server handoff in planning mode until credentials are provided.
gaps.closureMetric: Server target profile receives explicit host, user, and safe path without hardcoded secrets.
gaps.rollback: Ship local and iCloud artifacts only.

gaps.label: Polyglot lane drift
gaps.impact: New language lanes must update matrix, manifest, starter files, checks, and docs together.
gaps.nextAction: Use the polyglot checker before and after every language-lane change.
gaps.closureMetric: Software language matrix count, manifest count, source starters, and docs stay in parity.
gaps.rollback: Revert the whole lane bundle if any contract layer is missing.

rules: Each gap must include impact, nextAction, and rollback.
Each gap must include priority, closureMetric, and at least one quality command.
Blocked gaps must stop before secrets, credentials, or remote pushes.
Ready gaps can become one small reversible implementation slice.
Watch gaps need evidence before heavier runtime work.
